sloka: ना अन्यो दोषो भवेत् अत्र मृगेभ्यः अन्यत्र विद्धि वै ।तत्  श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य महर्षेः लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ॥३-७-१९॥
transliteration: nā anyo doṣo bhavet atra mṛgebhyaḥ anyatra viddhi vai ।tat  śrutvā vacanam tasya maharṣeḥ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ॥3-7-19॥

translations.english: When heroic Rama heard that there was no other problem from the wild animals except their frequent incursions, he lifted his bow with an arrow and said these words:
